STATOR CHECK
1. Check the continuity between the coil lead. If there is no 
continuity, replace the stator.
2. Check the continuity between the coil and the core. If there 
is continuity, replace the stator.
RECTIFIER CHECK
1. A positive rectifier test checks the continuity between the 
positive rectifier and the stator coil lead connection terminal 
with a tester. If there is continuity at both terminals, the diode 
is shorted, so replace the rectifier.
